messages:
Maya Chen: Quick kickoff — planning FY26 Q3 GTM. Main asks: PLG experiments to boost self-serve conversion, localized enablement for EU, and firm sales targets for EU/APAC. Wed 10am sync. Who's in?
Liam O'Connor: I'm in. Quick question — do we try to include a Dedicated pilot in Q3 or push to Q4? Sales keeps asking.
Sophia Reyes: Marketing: we need a concise enablement playbook + localized one-pager (FR/DE) if we're targeting EU mid-market. Also demo script variants.
Kyle Park: Sales numbers (prelim): EU new ARR target $650k, APAC $300k => Q3 new ARR $950k. Pipeline today ~18 opps, average ACV ~$40k. Hitting target requires better PLG funnel and localized assets.
Ana Duarte: Proposed PLG experiments: 1) Simplify signup (remove forced SSO), 2) Give ~1000 trial credits for embeddings, 3) Add in-app onboarding tour + contextual tips. Aim: +15% trial->paid.
Maya Chen: Agree. Launch criteria for the PLG experiment: instrumentation in place, no >5% negative regression on activation, and either +15% trial->paid or clear path to iterate. Need analytics + eval hooks.
Liam O'Connor: For Dedicated pilot: suggest limiting to 3 named customers with SLA add-on. Engineering estimate: ~2 sprint effort for onboarding + docs. My recommendation: defer unless Sales can commit 2 signed pilots by mid-Q3.
Sophia Reyes: Enablement checklist (rough): one-pager, battlecards, demo script, localized pricing table, FAQ for Dedicated questions. If no scope creep, I can deliver drafts in 2 weeks.
Kyle Park: I support deferring Dedicated to Q4. Sales will keep pushing, but let's prioritize capacity for PLG + regional GTM.
Ana Duarte: Experiment timeline proposal:
```
Week 0: feature flags + analytics events
Week 1-2: run A/B tests on signup & credits
Week 3-4: run onboarding tour experiments
Week 5: analyze + decision
```
Is design + 1 eng available?
Maya Chen: We can allocate 1 engineer + 1 designer for ~6 weeks. I'll write a short RFC by EOD Monday with scope and success metrics.
GrowthBot: Reminder: experiment template + KPI tracker -> https://docs.redwood.ai/plg-experiments (use the PLG KPI sheet)
Sophia Reyes: Localization: FR/DE translations estimated $6k. Approve? We need translated marketing copy + pricing table.
Kyle Park: Approve localization spend. Sales will help validate wording with early customers.
Maya Chen: Action items: Maya -> RFC; Ana -> experiment plan + metric sheet; Sophia -> enablement assets + localization kickoff; Kyle -> refine sales targets & share pipeline list. Sync Wed 10am. :calendar:
Liam O'Connor: :thumbsup:
Sophia Reyes: I'll post the draft playbook to this thread by EOD Tuesday for review.
Maya Chen: If nobody objects to deferring Dedicated for Q3, we'll mark it out-of-scope and focus on PLG + regional enablement. Any objections?
Kyle Park: No objections. Locking scope.
Ana Duarte: Noted. I'll include the KPIs in the experiment doc:
```
- trial_to_paid_delta >= +15% (30 days)
- activation_time <= baseline * 0.8
- churn_no_growth (no negative signal)
```
Maya Chen: Perfect. Thanks everyone — we'll go into Wed sync with RFC + experiment plan.
Sophia Reyes: Posting assets soon.
Liam O'Connor: Thanks, team.
